note: The Privacy Commissioner's Credit Reporting Privacy Code 2020 (as at 1 May 2026), Schedule 1: repayment history information may be reported two years from the month following the payment's due date; credit default information, a further listing the game doesn't model, five years. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.
